sn22.54:1.4: mūlabījaṃ khandhabījaṃ phalabījaṃ aggabījaṃ bījabījaññeva pañcamaṃ.
sn22.54:1.5: imāni cassu bhikkhave pañca bījajātāni akkhaṇḍāni apūtikāni avātātapappahatāni sārādāni sukhasayitāni paṭhavī ca nāssa āpo ca nāssa.
sn22.54:1.6: api numāni bhikkhave pañca bījajātāni vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyunti.
sn22.54:1.8: imāni cassu bhikkhave pañca bījajātāni akkhaṇḍāni …pe… sukhasayitāni paṭhavī ca assa āpo ca assa.
sn22.54:1.9: api numāni bhikkhave pañca bījajātāni vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyunti.
sn22.54:1.11: seyyathāpi bhikkhave paṭhavīdhātu evaṃ catasso viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo daṭṭhabbā.
sn22.54:1.12: seyyathāpi bhikkhave āpodhātu evaṃ nandirāgo daṭṭhabbo.
sn22.54:1.13: seyyathāpi bhikkhave pañca bījajātāni evaṃ viññāṇaṃ sāhāraṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
sn22.54:2.1: rūpūpāyaṃ vā bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya rūpārammaṇaṃ rūpappatiṭṭhaṃ nandūpasevanaṃ vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
sn22.54:2.2: vedanūpāyaṃ vā bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya …pe… nandūpasevanaṃ vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
sn22.54:2.4: saṅkhārūpāyaṃ vā bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya saṅkhārārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nandūpasevanaṃ vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.
sn22.54:3.2: ahaṃ aññatra rūpā aññatra vedanāya aññatra saññāya aññatra saṅkhārehi viññāṇassa āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā cutiṃ vā upapattiṃ vā vuḍḍhiṃ vā virūḷhiṃ vā vepullaṃ vā paññapessāmīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
sn22.54:4.1: rūpadhātuyā ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti
sn22.54:4.2: rāgassa pahānā vocchijjatārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.
sn22.54:4.6: viññāṇadhātuyā ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti
sn22.54:4.7: rāgassa pahānā vocchijjatārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.
sn22.54:4.9: vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ ṭhitattā santusitaṃ santusitattā na paritassati aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati.
